description: Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for any coordinates + IANA time zone, or a known city, for one day, several days or a whole month, plus the Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date and the next prayer with a countdown. Same astronomy as the website (adhan.js): 13 methods (Jordan Awqaf, MWL, Umm al-Qura, Egyptian, ISNA, Karachi, Dubai, Kuwait, Qatar, Turkey, Singapore, Tehran, Moonsighting), Shafi'i or Hanafi Asr, and the recommended high-latitude rule beyond 48° (overridable). Times are local HH:MM (24 h) in the given zone, plus UTC ISO. Coordinates are rounded to 4 decimals like the site. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/prayer-times/

asr.description: Asr school: "shafi" (standard: Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali) or "hanafi". Default shafi (hanafi for Karachi-method cities).

city.description: A known city (sets coordinates, time zone and its usual method): amman, irbid, zarqa, aqaba, mecca, medina, riyadh, jeddah, jerusalem, gaza, damascus, beirut, baghdad, cairo, alexandria, dubai, abudhabi, doha, kuwait, manama, muscat, istanbul, casablanca, tunis, algiers, khartoum, karachi, lahore, dhaka, delhi, kualalumpur, jakarta, tehran, london, paris, berlin, newyork, chicago, toronto, losangeles, sydney.

date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the place's calendar. Default: today there.

days.description: How many consecutive days to return.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees (−90..90). Use with longitude and timezone.

method.description: Calculation method. Default: the city's usual method, else "mwl".

month.description: Or a whole month timetable, YYYY-MM (overrides date/days).

now.description: Reference instant (ISO 8601) for "today" and the next prayer. Default: the current time.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the place, e.g. "Asia/Amman" (required with coordinates; overrides the city's).

name: prayer_times
title: Prayer times
